name: medconnect-automation-framework
description: Suite empresarial de automatización con Cypress + JavaScript

scripts.clean:reports: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('cypress/reports', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('cypress/screenshots', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.report:merge: node -e "const { merge } = require('mochawesome-merge'); const fs = require('fs'); merge({ files: ['cypress/reports/mocha/*.json'] }).then(r => fs.writeFileSync('cypress/reports/report.json', JSON.stringify(r)));"
scripts.report:generate: npx marge cypress/reports/report.json --reportDir cypress/reports --html true --json false --charts true --reportPageTitle "MedConnect-Regression-Report" --inlineAssets true
scripts.test:regression: npm run clean:reports && (npm run cy:run || cd .) && npm run report:merge && npm run report:generate
